review_scope: First incremental set on dexterous manipulation: supervised imitation, fixed-data RL, online and offline-to-online RL. Not an exhaustive systematic review.

papers.name: DP3
papers.title: 3D Diffusion Policy: Generalizable Visuomotor Policy Learning via Simple 3D Representations
papers.embodiment: 仿真多种手型；实机 3 个 Allegro 手臂手任务及 1 个夹爪任务
papers.use: 灵巧操作可以由监督式模仿学习取得较好结果；表示与数据质量影响效果。
papers.limitation: 并非 π0.5 SFT 与 RL 的受控比较；实机汇总结果包含夹爪任务。
papers.open_scope: 官方策略代码，项目页提供仿真与实机数据入口

papers.name: DexMimicGen
papers.title: DexMimicGen: Automated Data Generation for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation via Imitation Learning
papers.embodiment: 双臂灵巧操作；仿真与 Real2Sim2Real 验证
papers.use: 扩展示范数据覆盖是可行的性能改善路径，不能预设 RL 是唯一选择。
papers.limitation: 示范扩展本身有采集／生成成本；不能据此证明单个通用 VLA 联合训练一定成功。
papers.open_scope: 官方仓库明确提供仿真环境与数据集；未认定完整生成管线均开源

papers.name: IQL
papers.title: Offline Reinforcement Learning with Implicit Q-Learning
papers.setting: 固定数据 offline RL，另有 offline-to-online 实验
papers.embodiment: D4RL，包括仿真 Adroit 灵巧手与 Kitchen
papers.use: 固定经验可用于价值学习与优势加权；原文指出其 Adroit / Kitchen 中多数 RL 方法与模仿学习接近。
papers.limitation: 表 3 是归一化回报，不是成功率；不证明现代视觉 π0.5 在灵巧手上的 RL 增益。

papers.name: DAPG
papers.title: Learning Complex Dexterous Manipulation with Deep Reinforcement Learning and Demonstrations
papers.setting: BC 初始化 + 示范辅助的在线策略梯度
papers.embodiment: 仿真 24 自由度灵巧手；搬移、笔操作、锤击与开门
papers.use: 示范可以帮助在线 RL 降低样本需求；是先模仿再交互优化的直接灵巧手证据。
papers.limitation: 论文以仿真为主；等效机器人小时不等于真实硬件训练小时；不是 flow VLA 方法。
papers.open_scope: 官方代码、示范及策略；训练算法与环境在关联仓库

papers.name: AWAC
papers.title: AWAC: Accelerating Online Reinforcement Learning with Offline Datasets
papers.embodiment: 仿真与实机；包括真实多指手、机械臂抽屉与阀门
papers.use: 先利用历史经验，再通过新增交互改善策略；连接离线数据复用与在线纠偏。
papers.limitation: 存在在线采集，不能把最终提升算作纯 offline RL；非现成 π0.5 配方。
papers.open_scope: 官方算法代码及环境入口

interpretation: The label dexterous manipulation alone does not determine the preferred learning objective.
IL/BC evidence is not automatically pretrained-VLA SFT evidence.
Simulation interaction is online interaction; deployment without updates does not make prior training offline RL.
Success/failure mixtures can be useful but are not required by the definition of offline RL.
Final offline-to-online gains must not be attributed solely to the offline phase.
Existing local RECAP degradation does not establish a general offline-RL disadvantage.

future_experiments.fixed_data: same checkpoint + frozen D: supervised expert/success replay versus offline RL
future_experiments.online: same checkpoint + initial D + matched interaction budget: online RL versus online success-replay loop
future_experiments.paired_replay: replay each collected dataset with different learners as a supplementary data-controlled comparison
